text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
My training journey! I really feel myself 
getting stronger! I want to be in peak 
condition for the ultimate showdown! So 
when I went to get my nails groomed—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
During the race, Ardan-senpai, who's in my 
year, was there! Looks like she'd been 
resting up. And then... Ardan-senpai told 
me something!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I want to change how people just see me as 
‘the sister of the legendary Mejiro 
Ramonu’... I want to leave behind a trace 
of light, proof that I truly lived—!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Her resolve and passion towards that 
"dream" were so overwhelming!! I... I 
just...!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has a burning "dream"!! I'll fire 
up my soul so I won't lose to anyone! For 
the sake of my... "dream"!!
